title: DNA OS ↔ GitHub Source Authority Connection
scope: Existing DNA OS GitHub source-authority connection: read/access status, source-execution one-file write/commit, credential resolution, branch targeting, result/evidence, and pure push-webhook verification. No new repository, credential, branch, worktree, or PR connection is introduced.

security.rule: Secret values are never recorded. Only credential reference names, Keychain metadata references, and the explicit legacy environment-channel name are recorded.

data_flow.read_path: CommandEnvelope → GitHub Capability Registry → handleGithubCommand → account-scope gate → credential reference → GET metadata → EventEnvelope/rejection
data_flow.write_path: ADMITTED Engineering result → DNA OS Commit Authority → DNA OS GitHub Publish Authority git-pushes that commit to the registered source_authority URL. GitHub Contents PUT and executeSource are DNA_OS_PUBLISH_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED for this registered repository.
data_flow.branch_path: Owner/source-execution supplies owner, repository, and branch explicitly; no default branch is inferred and no GitHub branch is created by this connection
data_flow.worktree_path: No local worktree is part of the GitHub connection; source execution receives content rather than reading a local checkout
data_flow.webhook_path: GitHub push delivery → trusted identity/secret lookup → constant-time HMAC → normalized push EventEnvelope; no listener is wired
data_flow.pr_path: No Pull Request path exists; source execution stops after the one-file commit result
